snippet.title: Angler's Journey - Official Demo Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Idle Clicker Incremental fishing game where you attack with different weapons to catch fishes, sell them to upgrade your equipment, unlock new skills. Explore diverse fishing spots, challenge mighty boss fishes, and strive to complete your massive fish collection.
